module_summary: MAC control-frame transmitter that serializes a parallel MCF header/params byte-by-byte via a pointer and merges it with priority into an AXI-stream data path, with pause handshake and skid-buffered output.

anchors.name: send_data_reg
anchors.why: Controller state: forwarding a data frame from input stream until tlast

anchors.name: send_mcf_reg
anchors.why: Controller state: serializing a MAC control frame onto output

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Byte pointer selecting which header/param byte is emitted each cycle

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input data stream valid; starts and advances data frame forwarding

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input stream ready, dropped while MCF is sent or pause requested

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input data bytes forwarded to output when sending data

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of input frame; ends data state and allows MCF insertion

anchors.name: mcf_valid
anchors.why: Control-frame request valid; triggers send_mcf state between frames

anchors.name: mcf_ready
anchors.why: Control-frame accept, asserted near last serialized byte

anchors.name: mcf_params
anchors.why: Control-frame parameter bytes serialized after header fields

anchors.name: mcf_eth_dst
anchors.why: Destination MAC header field serialized at pointer offsets 0-5

anchors.name: mcf_opcode
anchors.why: MAC control opcode field serialized at offsets 14-15

anchors.name: tx_pause_req
anchors.why: Pause request blocking new input frames at frame boundaries

anchors.name: tx_pause_ack
anchors.why: Pause acknowledge asserted when idle between frames

anchors.name: stat_tx_mcf
anchors.why: Pulse reporting completion of a transmitted control frame

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Output byte mux: input data or serialized MCF header/params

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from output register

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Output stream ready controlling skid buffer transfers

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream data from output register

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Output register stage of the skid buffer

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp register holding a beat while output stalled

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp-register occupied flag affecting early ready

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating MCF byte advance and skid stores

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_early
anchors.why: Early internal ready feeding input ready computations

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable: internal beat into output register

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable: internal beat into temp register

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable: temp register into output register

groups.name: Frame scheduler
groups.description: Chooses between forwarding data frames and inserting MAC control frames, handles pause

groups.name: MCF serializer
groups.description: Pointer-indexed byte mux emitting header and params onto internal stream

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers providing registered AXI-stream backpressure

groups.name: Input stream
groups.description: Input AXI-stream payload sideband passed to internal stream
